title: capturing
description: Morphism: (handler-class, payload) -> captured claim(s). Realizes the IO-ARTICULATION rule (external I/O -> utterance -> articulating -> claim) so that ALL activity -- tool calls, prompts, llm completions, hook events -- is transduced into claims the swarm can process. Composes decoding (locution) -> articulating. PURE; the durable dual-filed write is the capture entrypoint's job. HACKING: name admitted.
